== Editing ==
English Decipher-era comparison for [[Evader]]. Columns cover distinct published text states in date order: the printed card, Decipher's errata and every Players Committee errata image; the stamp row describes the displayed rendition. Revised, Japanese, foil, and Virtual printings remain in Versions. Yellow highlights mark changed words against the column before.
